guidances.citation: Consolidated 2026 silver production is expected to be 15.3-16.1 million ounces, with low end raised compared to prior guidance of 15.1-16.1 million ounces.

guidances.libelle: coût en argent au comptant consolidé pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: Consolidated silver cash cost and AISC guidance improved to ($4.75)-($4.25)/oz and $11.50-$12.50/oz respectively,2,3 on outperformance during the first nine months of the year, reduced sustaining capital investment guidance, and higher by-product credits.2,3

Consolidated silver cash cost and AISC guidance improved to ($4.75)-($4.25)/oz and $11.50-$12.50/oz respectively,2,3 on outperformance during the first nine months of the year, reduced sustaining capital investment guidance, and higher by-product credits.2,3

guidances.libelle: investissement en exploration au Nevada pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: In Nevada, 2026 exploration investment guidance of $16 million is more than three times the 2025 level with expanded programs at Midas and new programs at Hollister and Aurora.

Consolidated silver production is expected to be 15.3-16.1 million ounces, with low end raised compared to prior guidance of 15.1-16.1 million ounces, and Greens Creek's gold production guidance of 51.0-55.0 koz is reiterated.

guidances.libelle: production d'or de Greens Creek pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: Consolidated silver production is expected to be 15.3-16.1 million ounces, with low end raised compared to prior guidance of 15.1-16.1 million ounces, and Greens Creek's gold production guidance of 51.0-55.0 koz is reiterated.

guidances.libelle: production d'argent de Greens Creek pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: Greens Creek's silver production is expected to be 8.0-8.3 million ounces, unchanged from prior guidance.

guidances.libelle: production d'argent de Lucky Friday pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: Lucky Friday's silver production is expected to be 5.0-5.2 million ounces, with low end raised from the prior 4.9-5.2 million ounces.

guidances.libelle: production d'argent de Keno Hill pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: Keno Hill's silver production is expected to be 2.3-2.6 million ounces, with low end raised from the prior 2.2-2.6 million ounces.

guidances.libelle: coût en argent au comptant et AISC total pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: Total silver cash cost and AISC guidance per silver ounce is improved to ($4.75)-($4.25)/oz and $11.50-$12.50/oz respectively.2,3

guidances.libelle: coûts applicables aux ventes de Greens Creek pour l'exercice 2026
guidances.citation: At Greens Creek, guidance for costs applicable to sales (excludes depreciation) at $250 million, up $10 million from the prior guidance due mostly to actual results over the first nine months and higher expected power generation on site in the fourth quarter.
